# The 2d template on the kernel alone (#1624, scripts/package-kernel-2d.py):
# the player sprite moves under WASD and the HUD draws, with no package in
# the build. The template's player starts at (0, -1) and moves 6 units a
# second, so half a second of D puts it near x = 3.
0.0  expect player transform.position.x == 0
0.1  down KeyD
0.6  up KeyD
0.7  expect player transform.position.x > 2
0.8  down KeyW
1.1  up KeyW
1.2  expect player transform.position.y > 0
1.3  expect frame hud contains "WASD"
